phase_types.title: Load
phase_types.description: Cold load only: unload the profile if it is loaded, then load it without sending any chat request and wait until it is ready.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: cold
options.description: Drop the model file from the file cache of every node the load will use and of the scheduler's machine first, so the load reads the file from disk or the share. The result says whether that was verified (under 1 % of the file left cached everywhere).

phase_types.title: Warm-up
phase_types.description: Send requests that are recorded but left out of the statistics, so a cold cache does not skew the measured ones.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: count
options.description: How many warm-up requests to send.

options.name: request
options.description: The request to send (default: the first request of the requests phase).

phase_types.title: Requests
phase_types.description: The measured requests: each prompt is sent `repeats` times and statistics are computed over them.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: requests
options.description: The prompts or chats to send.

options.name: repeats
options.description: How many times each request is sent.

options.name: cache_prompt
options.description: Default for requests that do not set it: reuse the cached prompt.

options.name: max_tokens
options.description: The most tokens one answer may have.

options.name: temperature
options.description: Sampling temperature; 0 makes the output repeatable, so its hash can be compared between runs.

options.name: seed
options.description: Sampling seed.

options.name: stream
options.description: Stream the answer, which also measures the time to first token.

phase_types.title: Conversation
phase_types.description: A multi-turn exchange: each turn is sent with all earlier turns and the model's replies, which measures how much of the prompt the server reuses.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: system
options.description: An optional system message that starts the conversation.

options.name: turns
options.description: The user's messages, in order.

options.name: cache_prompt
options.description: Let the server reuse the cached earlier turns.

options.name: max_tokens
options.description: The most tokens one answer may have.

options.name: temperature
options.description: Sampling temperature; 0 makes the output repeatable, so its hash can be compared between runs.

options.name: seed
options.description: Sampling seed.

options.name: stream
options.description: Stream the answer, which also measures the time to first token.

phase_types.title: Context fill
phase_types.description: A conversation that fills the model's context to a share of its size with generated filler (the same seed gives the same text), counted with the model's own tokenizer. Each mark is one turn; after it the tokens held and every machine's available memory are recorded, and the growth per token is worked out. The last turn asks back the facts planted in the filler. The step stops, and the model is unloaded, when a machine's available memory would fall below the stop line. By default it refuses to run on a shape (model, context and options) that a profile a person wrote shares, because the step's memory peak becomes that shape's stored peak.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: fill_pct
options.description: The share of the context to fill.

options.name: marks_pct
options.description: Where a turn ends and a reading is taken, rising, ending at fill_pct (default 25, 50, 75 below it, then fill_pct).

options.name: recall
options.description: How many facts to plant in the filler and ask back at the end (0: none, the last turn only asks for OK).

options.name: seed
options.description: Seed of the filler and the facts; also the sampling seed.

options.name: max_tokens
options.description: The answer budget of the last turn (earlier turns answer in at most 8 tokens).

options.name: stop_available_mib
options.description: Stop the step when any machine's available memory falls, or would fall with the next turn, below this.

options.name: refuse_shared_shape
options.description: Refuse the step when a profile a person wrote has the same shape (model, context, parallel and options), so the fill's memory peak cannot move that profile's plan. Whatever it says, a step whose own profile a person wrote is always refused: use the recipe.

options.name: settle_s
options.description: The hold after the load before the first turn, so the scheduler takes the cycle's settle use and the growth reading can be worked out. Default: the scheduler's free_average_window (30 s unless configured); 0: no hold.

phase_types.title: Hold
phase_types.description: Keep the model loaded and idle for a while, then send one request to see how it behaves after the idle time.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: seconds
options.description: How long to stay idle.

options.name: request
options.description: The request sent afterwards (default: the first request of the requests phase).

phase_types.title: Simultaneous requests
phase_types.description: Send n requests to the same profile at the same moment and record each one's wait and decode speed, the total time and the errors.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: n
options.description: How many requests to send together.

options.name: request
options.description: The request every one of them sends (default: the first request of the requests phase).

phase_types.title: Tasks
phase_types.description: Send each task of a task set once, in order, with the profile loaded (temperature 0, the set's seed, streamed), and keep every answer with its tokens and speed so it can be scored later. Potluck never runs the answers and does not score them: a scorer posts its points to the run afterwards. A task that fails or runs out of time is recorded and the next one is sent.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: task_set
options.description: The id of a task set stored with POST /api/bench/task-sets. Give this or tasks.

options.name: task_set_version
options.description: The version of the stored task set (default: its newest version when the phase starts).

options.name: tasks
options.description: A task set given inline, in the same format as a stored one. Give this or task_set.

options.name: timeout_s
options.description: Limit for the whole phase; tasks not sent by then are recorded as not sent. Default: what the benchmark's timeout_s leaves, minus 30 s for the unload.

phase_types.title: Unload
phase_types.description: Unload the profile and record how long it takes until the instance is gone.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

request_options.name: name
request_options.description: A short label for the request (default request-N).

request_options.name: prompt
request_options.description: The prompt, sent as one user message. Give this or messages.

request_options.name: messages
request_options.description: A full chat: a list of {role, content}. Give this or prompt.

request_options.name: cache_prompt
request_options.description: Let the server reuse the cached prompt; off means every request does its full prefill.

request_options.name: max_tokens
request_options.description: The most tokens one answer may have.

request_options.name: temperature
request_options.description: Sampling temperature; 0 makes the output repeatable, so its hash can be compared between runs.

request_options.name: stream
request_options.description: Stream the answer, which also measures the time to first token.

turn_options.name: name
turn_options.description: A short label for the turn (default turn-N).

turn_options.name: content
turn_options.description: What the user says in this turn.

turn_options.name: max_tokens
turn_options.description: Overrides the phase's max_tokens for this turn.

benchmark_options.name: id
benchmark_options.description: Lower-case letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_'; up to 64 characters.

benchmark_options.name: description
benchmark_options.description: What this benchmark does and measures, shown while it runs.

benchmark_options.name: profile
benchmark_options.description: The profile (or alias) of this scheduler to benchmark. Give this (a fixed profile) or inputs (a recipe).

benchmark_options.name: inputs
benchmark_options.description: Makes the benchmark a recipe: the defaults of its inputs (see input_options). The profile is made from the inputs when the recipe is used in a group or run directly; a group entry or the run fills in what is missing (model and ctx are needed).

benchmark_options.name: phases
benchmark_options.description: What to do, in order. Without phases the simple form (cold, warmup_requests, requests, repeats, unload_after) is used.

benchmark_options.name: timeout_s
benchmark_options.description: Limit for the whole benchmark, load and holds included.

suite_options.name: stop_on_failure
suite_options.description: Skip the rest after a benchmark fails.

suite_options.name: only_when_idle
suite_options.description: Wait while models are loaded, requests are running or the queue is not empty; skip the run when it stays busy longer than idle_wait_s.

suite_options.name: idle_wait_s
suite_options.description: How long to wait for the scheduler to be idle.

suite_options.name: evict_others
suite_options.description: Do not wait for other users' idle loaded models: the run's loads may make the scheduler unload them to make room, as any load does. Requests in flight and queued requests are still waited for.

input_options.name: model
input_options.description: The model file under the models directory.

input_options.name: placement
input_options.description: Where the model goes, agent zones only (not the scheduler's machine): auto (Potluck chooses), all (every zone that can take a load), any:N (N zones, those with the most available memory), nodes:a,b (these zones). A placement that cannot be met when the step starts is a refused step.

input_options.name: thinking
input_options.description: false turns the model's reasoning off (--reasoning-budget 0); leave it out to keep the model's default.

input_options.name: kv_quant
input_options.description: Key-value cache precision; q8_0 and q4_0 need flash_attn.

entry_options.name: benchmark
entry_options.description: A stored benchmark. With inputs or matrix it must be a recipe.

entry_options.name: inputs
entry_options.description: Inputs for this use of the recipe; they override its defaults.

entry_options.name: matrix
entry_options.description: Lists of model, placement, ctx and thinking: the entry stands for every combination (model outermost), at most 500.

entry_options.name: group
entry_options.description: Another group (suite), run where it stands with its own entries; its run options are not used. Give this or benchmark.

expect_keys.name: outcome
expect_keys.description: What the scheduler should do: ready (default), refused (it declines before loading) or failed (the load fails).

expect_keys.name: max_load_s
expect_keys.description: The load must take at most this long.

expect_keys.name: min_decode_tps
expect_keys.description: Mean decode speed must be at least this.

expect_keys.name: min_prefill_tps
expect_keys.description: Mean prompt-processing speed must be at least this.

expect_keys.name: max_ttft_ms
expect_keys.description: Mean time to first token must be at most this (needs a streamed phase).

expect_keys.name: output_sha256
expect_keys.description: The first request's output must hash to this (needs temperature 0).

expect_keys.name: min_reused_tokens
expect_keys.description: Every turn after the first must reuse at least this many prompt tokens from the cache.

expect_keys.name: max_concurrent_wall_s
expect_keys.description: All simultaneous requests together must finish within this time.

expect_keys.name: max_errors
expect_keys.description: At most this many simultaneous requests may fail (default: not checked).

expect_keys.name: max_unload_s
expect_keys.description: The instance must be gone within this time of the unload.

templates.name: Load only
templates.description: Measures just the cold load of a profile: how long it takes, how many bytes go to which worker and how much memory it uses. No chat request is sent.

benchmark.name: Load only
benchmark.description: Cold load, then unload. Measures load time and upload rate only.

templates.name: Load and requests
templates.description: A cold load, one warm-up, then measured requests repeated several times, then unload.

benchmark.name: Load and requests
benchmark.description: Cold load, a warm-up and 3 measured requests.

requests.name: explain
requests.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a GPU does.

templates.name: Load and conversation
templates.description: A cold load followed by a multi-turn conversation, to see prefill, decode and how much of the earlier turns the server reuses.

benchmark.name: Load and conversation
benchmark.description: Cold load, then a 3-turn conversation with prompt caching.

turns.content: Name three uses of a hash table.
Give a one-line example of the second one.
Now summarise our conversation in one sentence.

templates.name: Requests on a loaded model
templates.description: No load and no unload: sends requests to whatever is loaded (the model is loaded first if it is not).

benchmark.name: Requests on a loaded model
benchmark.description: Measured requests only; leaves the model loaded.

requests.name: explain
requests.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a GPU does.

templates.name: Simultaneous requests
templates.description: Loads the model, then fires several identical requests at once to see how the scheduler and the model share the time.

benchmark.name: Simultaneous requests
benchmark.description: Cold load, then 4 requests at the same moment.

templates.name: Cold, reload, loaded
templates.description: A load from an empty file cache, the first answer, the loaded speed, then an unload and a reload from the file cache with its first answer: cold load and reload times, time to first token after each, and the steady speed.

benchmark.name: Cold, reload, loaded
benchmark.description: Cold load (file caches dropped first), first answer, loaded speed; then unload, reload from the file cache and its first answer.

requests.name: explain
requests.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a GPU does.

requests.name: explain
requests.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a GPU does.

templates.name: Tasks
templates.description: A cold load, then every task of a task set sent once (temperature 0, streamed), then unload. The answers are kept for a scorer to post points; replace the inline set with task_set: "<id>" to use a stored one.

benchmark.name: Tasks
benchmark.description: Cold load, the tasks of a task set, unload.

tasks.prompt: Write a Python function fib(n) that returns the n-th Fibonacci number.
Write a SQL query that returns the three highest salaries per department from employees(name, department, salary).

templates.name: Cold load recipe
templates.description: A recipe: no fixed profile, it takes its model, context and placement as inputs, so one definition serves every model. Use it in a group with inputs or a matrix, or run it with inputs.

benchmark.name: Cold load
benchmark.description: Cold load, first answer, unload; for any model.

templates.name: Context fill recipe
templates.description: A recipe that fills the context of any model to 90 % with generated filler, reading every machine's memory at 25, 50, 75 and 90 %, then asks back the facts planted in the filler. Pick a context no profile you wrote uses: by default the step refuses a shape a written profile shares, because its memory peak becomes that shape's stored peak.

benchmark.name: Context fill
benchmark.description: Load, fill the context to 90 % in four turns, recall, unload; for any model.
